quote: On November 22, 2022, Akamai Technologies, Inc. (the "Registrant") entered into a $500 million five-year, revolving credit agreement (the "Credit Agreement") with the financial institutions identified therein as Lenders and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as Administrative Agent.
